analysis.title: Global Equity Volatility Insights: The age of idiosyncratic risk
key_insights: AI-driven weakness is trading as a growth shock: on 22-Oct the 10y yield fell more than 16bps as the Nasdaq declined nearly 3%. BofA keeps its preference for NDX max lookback puts contingent on lower rates as a longer-term AI hedge.

Healthcare and staples have seen a historic rotation that pushed their Bubble Risk Indicators (BRI) toward bubble-risk levels, among the highest globally. Defensives showed similarly high BRIs in the late-90s Dotcom bubble and the post-COVID melt-up.
BofA reads the defensive froth as further evidence that markets are moving toward a more reflexive, boom-bust-prone regime, a view first put forward in its 2026 Year Ahead report.
The NDX-SPX vol spread, both implied and realized, has widened again. This supports BofA's preference for owning Nasdaq over S&P in delta and vol formats.

BofA says the passage of megacap earnings, the Oct FOMC meeting and the midterm elections could act as a clearing event for risk into year-end and catalyse a bullish shift in sentiment. It suggests defined-risk call spreads to participate.
Among ETFs, SMH and EEM Dec call spreads offer the highest payout ratios for a 1-sigma upside move. Among tech single stocks, TMUS and WDC Dec call spreads offer the highest payout ratios.
The Global Financial Stress Index (GFSI) rose from +0.09 on 16-Oct-26 to +0.20 on 23-Oct-26. That is its 66th percentile since 2000 and its highest level since 7-Apr, when it reached +0.33.

Commodities and equities are the most stressed asset classes and led the rise in stress. Crude implied vol stress hit its highest since 31-Jul, with its weekly increase in the 93rd percentile since 2000.
Credit, FX and rates stress all remain below their long-run medians. European stress is now above its long-run median, and Japan led regional stress higher.
The GFSI Risk Allocator suggests a 4.9% underweight as of 23-Oct-26, versus neutral on 16-Oct-26.
Froth in SPX stocks is localized compared with the dotcom era: 15 stocks have BRI above 0.8 today (2.2% of index weight), versus 50-100 stocks and 20-40% of index weight at the dotcom peak.

US single-stock fragility remains elevated: 3m ATM weighted-average stock vol is 38% for the SPX Top 50 (about 2.5x index vol) and 31% in Europe (about 1.8x SX5E). Europe is on track for one of its top five years for fragility events.

US earnings implied vol has risen but remains cheap, because realised earnings moves have risen more. The gap is largest for megacaps. Roughly two-thirds of SPX Top 50 market cap (more than half by count) recently moved more than options implied, a 98th percentile reading.
European earnings vol premium is rich: the excess vol priced around earnings is at its 94th percentile, but only about a third of European stocks recently realised moves larger than implied.

BRI is a price-based indicator built on returns, realized vol, momentum and fragility. Readings above 0.8 signal asymmetric near-term downside, but BofA treats it as a 'watch out' caution tool rather than a sell signal. Historical median 3m max draw-up was similar above and below 0.8.

sector_views.rationale: BRI is near bubble-risk levels after the historic rotation into defensives. BofA hedges the froth with XLV puts versus XLK puts.
BRI is near bubble-risk levels, among the highest globally. BofA hedges with XLP puts versus XLK puts.
AI wobble is weighing on US tech. BofA favours Nasdaq over S&P in delta and vol and sees call spreads on SMH as a post-catalyst participation vehicle.

earnings_insights: US earnings excess implied vol has risen but remains below the excess vol realised, particularly for SPX Top 50 index-weighted (megacap) names.
Roughly two-thirds of SPX Top 50 market cap, and more than half by count, have recently realised earnings moves larger than options implied (98th percentile).

European earnings excess implied vol premium is at its 94th percentile. Only about a third of SX5E names, and a similar share by market cap, recently realised larger moves than implied (33rd percentile).
BofA concludes US stock options offer value over reporting season while European earnings vol looks rich.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Yields fell as the Nasdaq dropped nearly 3%, which BofA reads as AI weakness trading as a growth shock.
Part of the AI-trade wobble that hit US tech last week.
Cross-asset stress at its highest since 7-Apr, led by commodities and equities.

crypto_views: Bitcoin and Ethereum are included in the BRI landscape (Exhibit 8). The text gives no specific readings or views for either.

trade_ideas.description: Buy NDX Sep27 90% max lookback put (daily obs.) contingent on 10y SOFR < ATMf-25bps for 3.62% indicatively (opened 12-Oct-26)
trade_ideas.rationale: If an AI slowdown plays out as equity lower and rates lower, the structure minimizes timing risk at low cost. Rates are unlikely to have fallen as far as they would in a prolonged AI unwind, and the premium is attractive against other long-dated hedges.

trade_ideas.description: NDX expanding put spreads contingent on rates lower, as a capped, lower-premium alternative
trade_ideas.rationale: More capped protection with a lower premium outlay.

trade_ideas.description: Buy Dec call spreads on SMH and EEM (ATM / +1-sigma) for a post-catalyst risk-on shift
trade_ideas.rationale: Highest payout ratios among options-liquid ETFs that have sold off since the 6-Oct NDX peak. Catalysts could act as a clearing event.

trade_ideas.description: Buy Dec call spreads on TMUS and WDC (ATM / +1-sigma)
trade_ideas.rationale: Highest payout ratios among options-liquid Nasdaq 100 stocks that have sold off since the 6-Oct peak. Moving the lower strike further out of the money would raise the potential payoff.

risk_factors: Prolonged AI-driven weakness trading as a growth shock.
Bubble-like dynamics building in defensive sectors, with high BRI readings signalling asymmetric near-term downside.
Single-stock fragility and outsized earnings-day moves, especially in US megacaps.
Rising cross-asset stress led by commodities and equities, with crude vol the largest riser.
Event risk from megacap earnings, the Oct FOMC meeting and the midterm elections.
BRI is price-based only and can give false positives or miss bubbles that end quietly.
charts_described: Exhibit 11: At its frothiest points, the dotcom bubble saw 50-100 S&P stocks with BRI above 0.8 versus about 15 today.
Exhibit 12: At its frothiest points, the dotcom bubble saw 20%-40% of S&P market cap with BRI above 0.8 versus 2.2% today.
Exhibit 15: Nasdaq 100 YTD performance against the YTD change in US 10y yields, with 10y yields down 16bps on 22-Oct as the Nasdaq fell nearly 3%.
Exhibit 24: More than half of US single names by count (more than two-thirds by market cap, 98th percentile) recently realised larger earnings moves than implied.
Exhibit 28: Only about a third of European stocks have recently realised larger moves than the options anticipated.
vol_and_positioning: Implied 3M vol rose over the week: S&P +0.9, ESTX50 +1.8, FTSE +1.4, DAX +1.7, NKY +1.9, KOSPI +3.6.
KOSPI realized 3M vol (66.7) is well above its implied (43.2).
VXN-VIX spread and the NDX-SPX 1m realized vol spread have widened in recent weeks.
Equity vol posted the largest stress increase among cross-asset vols and spreads (+0.26), but rates and commodity vols remain more stressed than equity vol.
ESTX50 skew had the largest stress gain among European subcomponents. European and Japanese equity skew were among the largest stress gainers.
Crude implied vol is the second most stressed GFSI subcomponent (1.42) and was the largest stress riser (+0.61) last week.
Hedging ideas: NDX max lookback puts contingent on 10y rates lower, NDX expanding put spreads contingent on lower rates, XLP/XLV puts versus XLK puts, VIX Nov 19-24 call spread.
geopolitical: Crude implied vol stress rose to its highest since 31-Jul, when the conflict in Iran was more active.
The Brazilian election-sensitive basket has a BRI of 0.94.
BofA lists hedges for French political, fiscal and sovereign risk and for Eurozone banks.
BofA lists US midterm elections as a catalyst and hedges against an adverse midterm outcome.

tension_points.bear_case: European earnings vol looks rich: implied earnings risk is near historical extremes, but only about a third of stocks have delivered larger moves than implied.

tension_points.bull_case: Megacap earnings, the Oct FOMC meeting and the midterm elections could act as a clearing event and catalyse a bullish shift in sentiment into year-end.
tension_points.bear_case: Prolonged AI-driven weakness would trade as a growth shock, with equities down and yields down, and BRI near bubble levels signals asymmetric downside.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A prolonged AI unwind with equities lower and rates lower, the scenario the NDX lookback put contingent on lower rates is built to hedge.
